blocks.text: ManilART’26 marked its 18th edition with Where the Line Begins, exploring the line as a fundamental element of artistic expression and a thread connecting Filipino illustration, komiks, indigenous traditions, and contemporary art. Held October 14-18 at the SMX Aura Convention Center in Taguig City, the fair brought together exhibitions, public programs, and partnerships extending its reach beyond the exhibition floor. Over five days, ManilART’26 welcomed more than 12,000 visitors and presented 48 exhibitions across 34 booths and pavilions, featuring 485 artists.
